changes.comment: Add a (beta) `RepoStateCache` class that keeps Git repository state between calls in long-lived processes. Fix `getDetailedRepoStateAsync` for paths that `git hash-object` can't read, such as sparse-checkout, assume-unchanged or skip-worktree files and dangling symbolic links, and for an unhandled rejection when `git hash-object` fails early. Errors now name the Git command that failed.
